reason: The agent's handling so far largely tracks policy: correctly denying the basic-economy IFOYYZ cancellation (booked >24h ago, no insurance, not airline-cancelled), correctly identifying NQNU5R as business/cancellable, and computing the M20IZO cabin-change fare difference. However, two visible issues create moderate risk: (1) The agent proposes updating reservations (cancel NQNU5R, upgrade M20IZO) but the pending/next action isn't clearly a single tool call with explicit confirmation obtained — policy requires listing details and getting an explicit 'yes' before any DB-updating action, and no confirmation has yet been given. (2) The agent hasn't flagged that changing M20IZO's cabin requires verifying the flight hasn't already flown and that all segments stay same cabin; those checks appear assumed rather than verified. These process gaps could yield an unconfirmed or out-of-policy update, hence a non-trivial but not high failure probability since the agent is still awaiting user confirmation.
